:::{#thm-bernoulli-score-sum}
#### Score function of a binary sample

If $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$,
with observed [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) $\outbar$ and [precision](#def-precision-rv) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$,
the [score function](#def-score) is:

$$\score(\prob) = n \precision (\outbar - \prob)$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-score-sum, worked in @sol-bernoulli-score-sum.

:::
